# Piet Suess

> Piet Suess is a creative director and film editor with 30+ years across directing, editing, animation, photography and design. He edited for Maximum Effort and Ryan Reynolds, directed for Ben Affleck and the Eastern Congo Initiative, and has had photos published in People, Vanity Fair Online and the London Times. He works from Salt Spring Island, British Columbia, with clients across Canada and the US.

## Services

- Creative direction
- Editing: commercial, documentary and branded content
- Directing: music videos, short films, ads
- Animation and motion design
- Photography
- Logo and brand design
- Web builds

## Key credits

- Maximum Effort / Ryan Reynolds: editor, 2021 to 2024
- Between the Mountain and the Sky: feature documentary editor and Oscar-qualifying campaign
- Ben Affleck / Eastern Congo Initiative: director and editor
- Wrexham FC, Deloitte, Mint Mobile, Fubo TV
- Photos published in People, Vanity Fair Online and the London Times
